const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  function eeGetInfo(eeObj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => eeObj.getInfo(resolve, reject));
  }

  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const dateStart = ee.Date('2024-11-08');
    const dateEnd = ee.Date('2024-11-09');
    const gaul = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1');

    const punjabFC = gaul.filter(ee.Filter.and(
      ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'India'),
      ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Punjab')
    ));
    const haryanaFC = gaul.filter(ee.Filter.and(
      ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'India'),
      ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Haryana')
    ));
    const punjabExists = await eeGetInfo(punjabFC.size());
    const haryanaExists = await eeGetInfo(haryanaFC.size());
    if (!punjabExists || !haryanaExists) {
      console.log(`Region check - Punjab features: ${punjabExists}, Haryana features: ${haryanaExists}`);
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }
    const punjabGeom = punjabFC.union().geometry();
    const haryanaGeom = haryanaFC.union().geometry();

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    let fc;
    try {
      fc = ee.FeatureCollection('MODIS/061/MCD14DL')
        .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd);
    } catch (e) {
      console.log('Dataset load failed: MODIS/061/MCD14DL');
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }
    const totalDayCount = await eeGetInfo(fc.size());
    // Proceed even if zero; zero is a valid result

    // 3. Processing: spatial filter to states, count features
    const punjabFires = fc.filterBounds(punjabGeom);
    const haryanaFires = fc.filterBounds(haryanaGeom);
    const punjabCount = await eeGetInfo(punjabFires.size());
    const haryanaCount = await eeGetInfo(haryanaFires.size());

    // 4. Validation
    const invalid = (v) => (v === null || v === undefined || Number.isNaN(v));
    if (invalid(punjabCount) || invalid(haryanaCount) || invalid(totalDayCount)) {
      console.log(`Counts invalid - Punjab: ${punjabCount}, Haryana: ${haryanaCount}, World: ${totalDayCount}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Evidence prints (<= 20 lines)
    console.log('Dataset: MODIS/061/MCD14DL (thermal anomalies, points)');
    console.log(`Date (UTC): 2024-11-08`);
    console.log(`Global detections (sanity check): ${totalDayCount}`);
    console.log(`Punjab fires: ${punjabCount}`);
    console.log(`Haryana fires: ${haryanaCount}`);

    // 6. Final Answer
    if (punjabCount > haryanaCount) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
